notes: Dictum 1.5.0 adds Meetings. It is off until you turn it on in Settings > Meetings and confirm the setup notice. Before each recording, Dictum shows what to tell everyone and asks you to confirm that each person agreed, spoken or in writing. If someone joins, recording pauses until you confirm they agreed too, and it stops at once if anyone says no. Dictum records your microphone, and your computer's sound when Windows allows it, shows a live transcript, and saves the audio in encrypted pieces as it goes. Before you start, Dictum names every service your audio or transcript will go to; summaries are written on this computer unless you choose Ollama or a cloud service with your own key. You can also import a recording once you turn imports on. Copy and Export show a sharing reminder first. Saved recordings stay until you delete them, or you can have the audio deleted after 30 or 90 days. The privacy policy on the website now has a Meetings section.
